summary: Full testing of new batch features: forgot password/reset flow, ResetView, Settings modal (autofill toggle), Help & Guide modal, breach badge, and phrase copy buttons. All features working correctly.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with generic message for unknown emails (intentional security behavior - prevents email enumeration). Test was updated to accept this.

critical_code_review_comments: Recovery endpoint returns HTTP 200 with generic message for non-existent emails — this is correct security practice (prevents email enumeration).
Breach badge shows red count (not green ✓) for test@toppass5.com user because one of the stored vault items has a known breached password value — this is correct behavior.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_reset_* and TEST_prefs_* users created during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: (1) Forgot password: clicking 'Forgot password?' on login shows forgot form, submitting shows modal with reset link and Copy button. (2) ResetView: /?reset=TOKEN shows password form, valid token resets password, invalid token shows error toast. (3) Settings modal: opens from sidebar Settings nav, has Browser Autofill toggle (default on), toggle works and persists via PUT /api/preferences. (4) Help modal: opens from Help & Guide nav, contains all sections (Advance Mode, Layer 3 Recovery Phrase, Breach Monitoring, Security Report, TOTP, etc.) with detailed descriptions. (5) Breach badge: shows red number count when breaches found (test user has 1 breach), shows ✓ (breach-ok class) when clean. (6) Backup phrase copy: 'Copy All Words' button present in both phrase-gen-modal (Backup Phrase sidebar) and phrase-reveal-modal (registration). Existing user credentials: test@toppass5.com / Test1234!
